Lina S: Quick Q - hiring manager signed for L6 but auto-band L5 landed. Candidate is local and can start 2026-06-01, will walk if we can't close today. Any emergency uplift flow?
Omar K: Can you share comp ask?
Lina S: Base $180k, band5 max is $155k. Manager okay with $180k + $10k sign-on.
Finance Ops: We can do provisional sign-on but need exec sponsor + PO confirmation. Benefits cutoff 5/29 for June payroll.
Lina S: Manager says losing them will delay roadmap deliverable. Can VP Eng sponsor quickly?
PeopleOpsBot: Created ticket AW-9991. Status: submitted -> committee -> finance. Link: https://internal.redwood/approvals/AW-9991
Omar K: I'll ping VP Eng now for exec sponsor. Add market comp and 3-month review milestone.
VP Eng: "Can provide exec stamp provisional. Proceed with contingent offer; committee must ratify"
Finance Ops: OK to proceed with contingent offer. Please note: include onboarding vs payroll split in offer if payroll can't be ready by 6/01.
Lina S: Drafted offer and sent to candidate: onboarding 2026-06-01, payroll 2026-06-08 if needed. Candidate accepted verbally. Uploading signed doc when returned.
PeopleOpsBot: AW-9991 update: committee approved provisional uplift at 1745556690. Finance approved pending PO. Ticket closed pending signed offer and PO."
